about_the_game:
About the Game

NANNA's plants are procedural and grow in real time. You are not to farm your plants in quantity but to create and produce the specific breeds of plants of your desire. You will garden to acquire fame, money, and friends' admiration. However, you are not the only one who is growing their desires. Talk to your friends and face the complex intertwined stories of the multiple characters struggling to garden what they should not.

Story

A farm resides in a room, as harm collides with doom.

Anna moves back to her hometown and attends her grandmother's reburial.

Moving into grandma's apartment, she realizes that she can finally focus on her passion.

The yearning to create the greatest plant that will mesmerize the world.

While she gardens in her room, her hometown friends find comfort in talking to Anna.

She hears the stories about the mafia, a chef, a private Investigator, a Bodyguard, a Cop, and many more.

Anna eventually realizes that she is not the only one who has been gardening desires.

Features

In NANNA, you will manage your time to create your best plant breed.

You will do the following activities :

  • Growing various plants and maximizing their stats and appearances. Plants in NANNA grow in real time and have randomized stats based on the values inherited from their parent plant. Pick out and plant the seed with the desired stat to fit your needs.  

  • Register and submit your plants to the contest with the various themes. There are contests for you to participate in, each with its own deadlines, rewarding you with hefty prizes and fame. Each will have an interesting theme like "Produce the Spiciest Fruit with Tons of Protein"; it will be important to create your know-how to make your creation shine.

  • Buying interiors / Decorating your room. It will be crucial to organize your room with efficiency in mind. As your room space is finite, you will have to place the furniture and items in a way that your plant breeding pipeline works the best. Meanwhile, making them look cute wouldn't hurt either. 

  • Hang out with your hometown friends and talk about their lives. You recently moved back to your hometown, you have some catching up to do with your friends. Hanging out with them will give you the unique benefits of leveling up your character stats or providing important information about helpful events. However, soon you will realize that not everything is going great for them.

  • Help your friends out with your plants. As the story proceeds, your friends will start asking you various favors, utilizing your talent in plant breeding. Handing them what they need will greatly improve your relationships with them, granting you even more benefits.

  • Work out, sing, study... live your life and level up your stats. You can also increase your mental and physical character stats on your own. Engaging in various activities will improve Anna in many aspects of gameplay, making gardening more efficient.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later versions
  • Processor: 2GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 mb video memory, shader model 3.0+
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

short_description: NANNA is a real-time indoor farming and life simulator where you create your own plant breeds. Decorate your room with efficiency in mind, while thrilling stories of various characters unfold. Groom your little garden and bear witness to a tangled web of dramatic events.
